background: NORD/LB is the Landesbank of Lower Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt, owned by the two states and the regional savings banks, a corporate, energy and real-estate lender that was recapitalised after shipping losses and also acts as central bank for its savings banks.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average, both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026; the rating rests heavily on the backing of its public-sector owners. Capital is sound, with CET1 of 17.4% and leverage of 5.7% both above the median of EU and Nordic banks, and CET1 has risen 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2025. Liquidity is mixed: LCR of 154% is above the median and has risen 18 points, but NSFR of 113% is in the bottom quarter, the one figure to watch. The one flagged item, on 5 Oct 2026, is an upgrade of its standalone rating with the long-term rating affirmed.
